_comment: Oculus Touch fallback binding for ust_hm_glove (research/40 §5.2).
Why this exists:
Virtual Desktop emulates the PICO 4 Ultra Touch controllers as
oculus_touch (controller_type=oculus_touch).  Without an explicit
oculus_touch binding entry in actions.json::default_bindings,
SteamVR auto-remaps bindings_index.json (knuckles) to oculus_touch
and SILENTLY SKIPs the /input/skeleton/* and /input/finger/* paths
because those paths do not exist on the oculus_touch profile.
vrserver.txt trace (2026-05-06 12:05:47):
[Remapping] Beginning remapping from knuckles to oculus_touch.
[Remapping] Skipped remapping of path::mode: /user/hand/left/input/skeleton/left::
[Remapping] Skipped remapping of path::mode: /user/hand/left/input/finger/index::trigger
... (all 10 finger paths skipped)
By providing this explicit oculus_touch binding we keep trigger +
grip alive on the VD-emulated PICO Touch controllers.  Skeleton +
per-finger curl come from the parallel UDCAP knuckles set
(bindings_index.json on LHR-E227UD40/41) -- those channels are
unaffected by this file because oculus_touch profile does not have
them.
Both grip and trigger are bound as 'mode: trigger' with 'pull' input
(matching the trigger/grip shape on oculus_touch -- they expose only
analog pull, not force_sensor).
description: PICO Touch (via Virtual Desktop) fallback: trigger + grip only (skeleton + 5-finger curl come from the parallel UDCAP knuckles binding)
name: UST Teleop -- oculus_touch fallback (trigger/grip)
